```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

::: {.tag-lime}
Eventos destacados
:::

```{r}
#| label: eventos-data
eventos <- tibble::tribble(
  ~lugar,             ~anio,
  "Ummo",             2023,
  "Bar Óxido",        2024,
  "Teatro Mori",      2024,
  "Mi Bar",           2025,
  "Teatro Lihuén",    2025
) |>
  arrange(anio) |>
  mutate(
    orden = row_number(),
    lado  = if_else(orden %% 2 == 0, 1, -1)
  )

kable(eventos |> select(lugar, anio), col.names = c("Lugar", "Año"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-eventos
#| fig-cap: "Presentaciones destacadas en vivo (2023-2025)"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(eventos, aes(x = orden, y = 0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#21272A", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = orden, y = 0, yend = lado * 0.6), color = "#726EFF") +
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "#CDFE03") +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 1, color = "#21272A", stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = lado * 0.6, label = paste0(lugar, "\n", anio)),
            vjust = if_else(eventos$lado > 0, -0.4, 1.3),
            family = "sans", fontface = "bold", color = "#21272A", size = 3.6) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA))
```
